extracted.intended_audience: employers, regulated entities, legal practitioners, and stakeholders involved in OSHA rulemaking and hearings
extracted.subtask_description: Compilation of 29 CFR Part 1911 headings describing OSHA procedures for petitions, promulgation/modification of standards, hearings, emergency standards, and decision/record certification processes. Useful for parties participating in or administering OSHA rulemaking and adjudicative hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.1  - Purpose and scope.
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of the purpose and the scope of Part 1911 (procedures related to standards and hearings).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.2  - Definitions.
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions of terms used in Part 1911.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.3  - Petition for the promulgation, modification, or revocation of a standard.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures governing petitions to promulgate, modify, or revoke OSHA standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.4 - Additional or alternative procedural requirements.
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority and processes for specifying additional or alternative procedures under Part 1911.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.5  - Minor changes in standards.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria relating to minor changes in existing standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.10 - [Reserved]
rubrics_metrics.description: Reserved section (no substantive text on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.11 - Standards.
rubrics_metrics.description: General provisions regarding issuance or content of standards under Part 1911.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.12  - Emergency standards.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and conditions for promulgation and application of emergency standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.15  - Nature of hearing.
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the nature, scope, and conduct of hearings under Part 1911.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.16  - Powers of presiding officer.
rubrics_metrics.description: Powers, duties, and authorities of the presiding officer at hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.17  - Certification of the record of a hearing.
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and process for certifying the hearing record.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1911.18  - Decision.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards governing issuance of decisions following hearings.
